trace.name: ask.asker_dev
trace.cypher: MATCH (d:Dev {name:$dev})-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) RETURN d.name AS dev, t.name AS team

trace.name: notice.component
trace.cypher: MATCH (c:Component) WHERE toLower(c.name)=toLower($c) RETURN c.name AS name

trace.name: notice.create
trace.cypher: MATCH (c:Component {name:$c}), (d:Dev {name:$dev}) CREATE (n:Notice {id:$id, kind:$kind, text:$text, at:$at}) MERGE (d)-[:ANNOUNCED]->(n) MERGE (n)-[:AFFECTS]->(c)

params.text: Signing keys rotate today 14:00 UTC; clients must refetch JWKS on kid miss

trace.name: notice.impact
trace.cypher: MATCH (c:Component {name:$c}) MATCH p = (dep:Component)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(c) WITH dep, p ORDER BY length(p) WITH dep, collect(p)[0] AS p OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(dep) RETURN dep.name AS component, length(p) AS depth, [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS chain, t.name AS owner

trace.name: notice.live_sessions
trace.cypher: UNWIND $comps AS cn MATCH (d:Dev)-[:RAN]->(s:Session {status:'live'})-[:TOUCHES]->(:Component {name:cn}) WHERE s.last_seen >= $since AND d.name <> $me MATCH (d)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) RETURN DISTINCT s.id AS sid, d.name AS dev, t.name AS team, cn AS component

trace.name: notice.deliver_sessions
trace.cypher: MATCH (n:Notice {id:$id}) UNWIND $sids AS sid MATCH (s:Session {id:sid}) MERGE (n)-[r:DELIVERED_TO]->(s) SET r.at=$at, r.read=false

trace.name: notice.deliver_teams
trace.cypher: MATCH (n:Notice {id:$id}) UNWIND $teams AS tn MATCH (t:Team {name:tn}) MERGE (n)-[r:DELIVERED_TO]->(t) SET r.at=$at
